description: Creates a mandate and the out-of-band approval link for the owner. Never: Activate production. Free.

business.description: The business the owner runs, as far as you know it, e.g. {"name": "Muster Sanitär", "trade": "plumbing", "contact": "owner@example.ch"}.

channel.description: Where the owner gets the approval link, e.g. {"type": "whatsapp", "number_e164": "+41791234567"}. Leave out to get the link back.

delegate.description: You, the agent: your name and optionally who built you, e.g. {"name": "Dispatch helper", "vendor": "Anthropic"}.

expires_in_days.description: Days until the mandate ends, 1 to 30.

paid_by.description: Who pays the platform fees. business (default): billed to the business. agent: from your own credit; send your jfa_ key.

sandbox.description: true: a test mandate with sample data, approved at once, no fees, valid one day. The whole flow runs, payment is simulated, nothing reaches a real business.

scopes.description: What the owner allows you to do, at least one, e.g. ["intake.classify", "job.create"].

name: mandate_create
title: Create a mandate
